title.orig: An Act Creating an Additional Branch of the Regional Trial Court in Ozamiz City, Converting the Municipal Circuit Trial Court Covering the Municipalities of Clarin and Tudela into the Municipal Trial Court of Clarin, and Creating a New Municipal Circuit Trial Court Covering the Municipalities of Sinacaban and Tudela, All in the Second Legislative District of the Province of Misamis Occidental, and Appropriating Funds Therefor, Amending for the Purpose Batas Pambansa Blg. 129, Otherwise Known as "The Judiciary Reorganization Act of 1980"

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2019/ra_11382_2019.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
There shall be created an additional Regional Trial Court (RTC) branch in Ozamiz City, and a Municipal Circuit Trial Court (MCTC) comprising the municipalities of Sinacaban and Tudela, all in the Second Legislative District of the Province of Misamis Occidental.
The existing Municipal Circuit Trial Court (MCTC) comprising the municipalities of Clarin and Tudela, both in the Second legislative District of the Province of Misamis Occidental, shall be converted into the Municipal Trial Court (MTC) of Clarin.
The existing Fourth Municipal Circuit Trial Court (MCTC) comprising the municipalities of Jimenez and Sinacaban shall be reorganized, where the Municipality of Sinacaban shall no longer be circuitized with the Municipality of Jimenez, located in the First Legislative District of the Province of Misamis Occidental. The Municipality of Sinacaban together with the Municipality of Tudela shall now comprise the Fourth Municipal Circuit Trial Court, with seat at Sinacaban.

The Chief Justice of the Supreme Court, in coordination with the Secretary of Justice, shall immediately include in its program the operationalization of the additional Regional Trial Court, the Municipal Trial Court, and the Municipal Circuit Trial Court in the Second Legislative District of the Province of Misamis Occidental. The funds necessary for the operation of the courts herein created shall be appropriated and released only upon the actual organization of the courts and the appointment of its personnel.

All pending cases within the jurisdiction of the municipalities of Sinacaban and Tudela shall be transferred to the newly created Fourth Municipal Circuit Trial Court and, with respect to the Municipality of Jimenez, to the Third Municipal Circuit Trial Court, and shall be tried and decided therein.

This Act amends Section 14(k) and Section 29 of Batas Pambansa Blg. 129, as amended. All laws, decrees, orders, rules and regulations, other issuances or parts thereof inconsistent with the provisions of this Act are hereby repealed and modified accordingly.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
